item.title: Upcoming Events
item.description:
SKEGNESS COACH TRIP - SOLD OUT!

Sunday 7th June 2026

Back by popular demand! Our bi-annual day trip to Skegness for our members, friends and families.

Tickets were available on a first-come, first-served basis and are very reasonably priced at just £15. Renal patients will get refunded on the day.

Sunday 7th June

Coach departs Leicester General Hospital @8AM

Coach return leaves Skegness @5PM

item.title: Previous Events
item.description:
Social contact is important for mental health and wellbeing, we hold events throughout the year for patients and their family members why not come along and join us.

We try to arrange a variety of events to suit different tastes and interests.

Christmas Meal 2025

Sunday 14th December 2025

Thank you to everyone who joined us for our Christmas meal and helped make it such a special occasion. It was a joy to come together and share festive cheer, good food, and great company.
